narr: Moisture plume remained through central New Mexico with an upper trough approaching from the west. This resulted in thunderstorms developing over the Sacramento Mountains with heavy rain falling on the Salt Burn scar resulting in flash flooding leading into Ruidoso Downs.
ev: The public reported high water flowing out of Bear Canyon and flooding of the Cherokee Mobile Village and along US 70 going into Ruidoso Downs.
lsr: Public report of high water flowing out of Bear Canyon, burn scar flooding of Cherokee Mobile Village and US-70 in Ruidoso Downs.
